system.description:
Choose one weapon group (see Weapon Training). You gain +1 to attack rolls and +1 damage with weapons of that group. You can change your group with one Downtime Phase of training.

  • Improves to +2 to hit and damage at 7th level, +3 at 13th and +4 at 19th

options.name: Bind
options.text: Bind (blades): +1 to hit and damage with its weapons (+2 at 7th, +3 at 13th, +4 at 19th). Weapon Training manoeuvre: make a Disarm contest against the target.

options.name: Hew
options.text: Hew (chopping and crushing): +1 to hit and damage with its weapons (+2 at 7th, +3 at 13th, +4 at 19th). Weapon Training manoeuvre: a creature your size or smaller makes a Fortitude save against your Class Save DC or is knocked Prone.

options.name: Hook
options.text: Hook (reach and tangling): +1 to hit and damage with its weapons (+2 at 7th, +3 at 13th, +4 at 19th). Weapon Training manoeuvre: make a Trip contest against the target, at your weapon's full reach.

options.name: Pinning Fire
options.text: Pinning Fire (missiles): +1 to hit and damage with its weapons (+2 at 7th, +3 at 13th, +4 at 19th). Weapon Training manoeuvre: the target has Disadvantage on its next attack roll.

options.name: Clinch
options.text: Clinch (fist weapons): +1 to hit and damage with its weapons (+2 at 7th, +3 at 13th, +4 at 19th). Weapon Training manoeuvre: make a Grapple contest against the target.
